description.text: Prosthodontists diagnose oral problems and design and fit fixed or removable prostheses. See the O*NET 29-1024 tasks, 2025 United States wages, the BLS 2025–2035 projection, and the Chinese practice and wage boundaries.

subject.name: Prosthodontists
subject.summary: Prosthodontists assess problems of the teeth, jaws, and oral and maxillofacial tissues, develop prosthodontic treatment plans, design and try in fixed or removable prostheses, adjust occlusion, function, and appearance, and collaborate with dental technicians and other physicians. Diagnosis, treatment, and procedures must be performed by personnel with the appropriate practice qualifications and institutional authorization.
